Highlight  – 9M’2025 Awards & Recognitions  
January 28, 2025: TTW received a certificate of honor "Low 
Emissions Support Scheme" (LESS) , which certifies that "a Solar 
Rooftop on a storage tank (tap water)" can efficiently reduce 
Greenhouse Gass Emissions by 2,263.422 tonCO2eq/year.
February 24, 2025: TTW received a “Carbon Footprint for 
Organization (CFO) certification 2025”  from the Thailand 
Greenhouse Gas Management Organization (Public Organization) 
for 3 consecutive years.
March 26, 2025: TTW was selected for the "Dividend Universe 
2025" list by SET Research.
to view the list of Dividend Universe 2025
May 27, 2025: TTW has received the "Low Emissions Support 
Scheme" (LESS)  certificate from Thailand Greenhouse Gas 
Management Organization (Public Organization), which certifies its 
tree planting activities, and solar rooftop aimed at saving the 
planet and reducing global warming, with an estimated 
greenhouse gas storage volume of 30.391 tonCO2e.
May 30, 2025: TTW received an award plaque for the “Ting To Trash”  
project from The Securities and Exchange Commission and Thai Listed 
Companies Association as a listed company with knowledge and 
understanding of the correct waste segregation method and creating an 
organizational culture that initiates greenhouse gas reduction, as well as 
disclosing information on waste segregation and the amount of waste that 
TTW has processed. (Verification period: Oct 2023 – Sep 2024)
July 24, 2025: TTW is 1 of 74 listed companies that received the "ASEAN 
Asset Class PLCs Award"  as part of the 2024 ASEAN CG Scorecard Project. 
This project is hosted by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) 
and the Thai Institute of Directors Association, in collaboration with capital 
market organizations from 6 ASEAN countries. The initiative aims to 
enhance the quality of supervision for business operations among listed 
companies in ASEAN, ensuring they meet international standards.
August 6, 2025: TTW received a full score of 100 from the Annual 
General Meeting Assessment 2025  (AGM Checklist)  by the Thai 
Investors Association (TIA).
Nov 27, 2025: TRIS Rating has affirmed the company rating on TTW 
Public Company Limited (TTW) and the ratings on its outstanding 
senior unsecured debentures at “AA-” with a “stable” outlook.
June 16, 2025: TTW was selected into the “SETESG Index ” for 
calculating the index during 2H’2025 by SET
Oct 29, 2025: TTW was evaluated on the “Corporate Governance 
Report of Thai Listed Companies 2025”  as “Excellent” by the Thai 
Institute of Directors (IOD) for 7 consecutive years.

## Page 12

12Benefits of investing in LPCL
Highlight  –  Acquiring 10% of LPCL’s Ordinary Shares
1.A sustainable long -term value policy
The transaction aligns with the Company’s investment policy, which seeks 
to create sustainable long -term value.
2.  Diversification
The transaction helps the Company diversify its investment risk and 
mitigate its reliance on the tap water business by increasing its 
investment proportion in the energy sector.
3.  Long -term Purchase Agreement 
It is the investment in the hydroelectric power business with a long -term 
power purchase agreement covering the entire concession period. 
4. All agreements have been finalized
All agreements related to the investment in the hydroelectric power 
business have been finalized.5.Expanding our investment in Hydropower sector.
The transaction expands the Company’s investment in run -of-river 
hydroelectric power and preserves its business opportunities in the sector.
6.  We’re familiar with “Run -of-River”
The transaction involves an investment in the run -of-river hydroelectric 
power business, which the Company is highly familiar with.              
The associated investment risk level is comparable to that of investing in CKP.
7.  Clean & Friendly
The project uses clean energy and is designed to be environmentally 
friendly.
8.  The long -run benefits for our nation.
Investing in a power project benefits the nation in the long -run.
